newsitem.title: USA: Roanoke Electric stake upped by Bass group.
newsitem.headline: Roanoke Electric stake upped by Bass group.

text.p: A group led by the Bass Family of Fort Worth, Tx., said Monday it raised its stake in Roanoke Electric Steel Corp to 507,300 common shares or 6.8 percent.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include the purchase of 106,200 common shares between May 8 and July 2 at prices ranging from $14.50 to $16.48 per share.
Roanoke, based in Roanoke, Va., is in merchant steel products and open web steel joists.
